messages.message: $listeners was removed in Vue 3 and merged into $attrs

messages.message: `$on()` was removed in Vue 3. The instance event-emitter API is no longer available.
messages.help: Vue 3 removed $on / $off / $once. Use an external emitter library (such as mitt) or refactor to props/emits instead. Note: $emit is still valid.
